resident_storage_bytes.excludes: temporary operand/result tiles, score panels, norm buffers, stream FIFOs and compiler replication

external_scratch_logical_accesses.boundary: Source-level scalar tensor accesses; repeated same-address expression loads assumed CSE. Not measured AXI traffic: caching, coalescing, burst widening and compiler scheduling can change physical bytes. Resident mapping relocates these accesses rather than eliminating their compute/local-storage cost.

other_logical_payloads.excludes: normalization/head/scale/bias parameter accesses, AXI transaction overhead, padding, repetition/cache behavior and initial model transfer

port_bound.boundary: Ideal necessary bound for this graph at the requested port clock. Achieved routed clock and sustained bandwidth are unmeasured; not a general BERT/FPGA bound or prediction of complete latency.

pl_only_comparison: Buffered PL has the same operation counts and can hold operator tiles, but dense multiplier allocation/clock and FP32 nonlinear costs are not measured here. No PL-only advantage claim; the implemented external/resident heterogeneous pair isolates scratch placement.
evidence_type: Analytical source counts; no synthesis, simulation-cycle, routed timing, board power or energy claim.
